description: Per-axis grade history for TOURney platform. Updated automatically by review skills. Operations Action Board reads this file.

scores.notes: Clean init layer, sensible MPA routing, good migration hygiene. Main gap: dual is_admin source-of-truth (players.is_admin column vs tournament_admins table). Settings key-value store is flexible but un-typed.
Three tournament structures (individual/team/pairs), 12 scoring formats, multi-day support, PWA install. Gap: round naming hardcoded day1/2/3, no tournament series concept, no score admin-edit UI.
Consistent dark gold design system, mobile hamburger on all pages. Empty states partially implemented. No loading skeletons — pages blank-flash while fetching. Accessibility not audited.

CRITICAL: player_accounts RLS USING (true) — any authenticated user can set billing_status=comped. CRITICAL: invitations RLS open to anon. XSS in admin.html (p.trash_talk, p.why_me unescaped). CSP header missing from vercel.json.

CRITICAL: invitations 'anon update own invitation' has USING(true) — no ownership predicate, any anon can update any invitation. CRITICAL: send-install-email edge function has zero auth check. HIGH: invitations 'auth manage invitations' USING(true) — any authenticated user manages all invitations. HIGH: player_accounts anon read exposes billing data. MEDIUM: _parseMentions(p.message) to innerHTML without escaping. MEDIUM: admin.html:2044/2194 url in innerHTML. CSP has unsafe-inline (nullifies XSS protection). Positives: stripe-webhook sig-verified, create-checkout auth-gated, no key leaks, esc() used consistently on player names, HSTS/X-Frame/nosniff all correct.

Stripe edge functions exist (create-checkout, stripe-webhook) and are wired but not live — blocked on LLC formation. No ToS or Privacy Policy pages. Billing gate in /create. player_accounts.billing_status column in place.

Vercel static deploy, clean routing, PWA with service worker. Security headers in vercel.json (HSTS, X-Frame, X-Content-Type). Manual test suite (test.js, 7 checks). Gap: no CI/CD, no Sentry, no analytics, no staging environment.

admin.html 151KB, home.html 144KB — heavy inline JS per page (no bundler). External deps: Supabase CDN, Google Fonts. SW precache covers critical path. No image optimization pipeline. Most pages use Promise.all for parallel DB queries.

5 migrations with clean progression. tournament_admins now canonical (is_admin column being deprecated). Settings key-value store flexible but un-typed. RLS gaps: player_accounts and invitations policies too permissive. No created_at/updated_at on all tables.
